questions.prompt: Where is the highest point above sea level on Earth (joint government survey, 2020)?
questions.teaser: Where is the highest point on Earth?
questions.authority: Governments of Nepal and China (joint survey)
questions.turnsOut: Mount Everest, on the Nepal–China border: 8,848.86 m, Nepal and China announced together on 8 December 2020. Until then Nepal had used 8,848 m, from a 1954 Survey of India, and China 8,844.43 m, the rock without its snow cap.
questions.sourceTitle: 8848.86 metres. That's the height of Mt Everest now (The Kathmandu Post)

questions.prompt: Where was the highest air temperature ever recorded on Earth (WMO)?
questions.teaser: Where was the hottest temperature ever recorded?

targets.label: Furnace Creek (Greenland Ranch), Death Valley, California, USA

questions.turnsOut: Furnace Creek in Death Valley, California, 54 m below sea level: 56.7 °C (134 °F) on 10 July 1913. Libya's 58 °C from 1922 held the title until a WMO panel threw it out in 2012.
questions.sourceTitle: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive: records table (31 July 2025)

questions.prompt: Where is the highest average annual rainfall in the WMO's records?
questions.teaser: Where does the most rain fall in a year, on average?
questions.turnsOut: Mawsynram, in the Khasi Hills of north-east India: 11,872 mm a year, averaged over 38 years. The WMO keeps this record by region, and Asia's is the highest. Neighbouring Cherrapunji holds the 12-month record: 26,470 mm from August 1860 to July 1861.
questions.sourceTitle: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive: records table (31 July 2025)
